intro.zh: mergeIntervals 收到一组 [开始, 结束] 区间，要把重叠的合并，返回覆盖同样范围的最少几个区间。现在它原样返回。
intro.en: mergeIntervals takes [start, end] intervals and should merge the overlapping ones into the fewest that cover the same ground. Today it returns them as they came.

zh: 重叠的区间合并成一个，结果按开始位置从小到大排。
首尾刚好相接的也要合并：[1, 2] 和 [2, 3] 变成 [1, 3]。
被完全包住的区间直接并进去。
不能改动传进来的数组和里面的区间。
en: Overlapping intervals become one; the result is ordered by start.
The input is not necessarily sorted.
Intervals that only touch are merged too: [1, 2] and [2, 3] become [1, 3].
An interval inside another disappears into it.
Do not change the array passed in, nor the intervals in it.

hint.zh: 先排序再扫一遍。注意 sort 会改原数组，合并时也别改到原来的区间。
hint.en: Sort, then one pass. Mind that sort changes the array it is called on, and that merging must not write into the original intervals.
